name: otp-input
summary: Digits pop into cells that size themselves, with SMS autofill and paste.
props: Controlled code (digits only). Pasting a longer string fills every cell.
Called when every cell is filled.
Rounded box cells, underline bars, or round pill cells.
Shakes the row and turns it the danger colour.
Message (with icon) shown under the cells while `error` is set.
Success colour with a staggered pulse across the cells.
Message with an animated check shown while `success` is set.
Hint shown under the cells otherwise.
Draw a dash after this many cells, e.g. 3 → 123 – 456.
Largest cell width; cells shrink to fit the row and never overflow.
Style for the root view around the cells and message.
behavior: Tapping the row focuses one hidden number-pad input. Pasting a code like 123-456 strips the non-digits and fills every cell.
Digits pop in on a bouncy spring and the active cell glows with a halo and a blinking caret. Errors shake the row; success pulses across the cells.
Sets textContentType 'oneTimeCode' and autoComplete 'one-time-code', so codes from SMS can autofill.
The cells are hidden; the input is labelled 'One-time code, 6 digits' with a hint. Helper, error and success messages are a polite live region.
The browser focus outline is removed; the border and halo show focus instead.
